The '''Mandalorian Crusades''' were a series of military campaigns launched by the [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] after the settlement of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] circa [[7000 BBY]]. It ended when the Crusaders were defeated at [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

==Prelude==
Thousands of years before the creation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], a [[Zhell–Taung war|war]] erupted between the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] and [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for the control of their shared [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After their defeat and their expulsion from Coruscant, the Taung relocated to [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] before claiming the planet [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] circa [[7000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==The Crusades==
The settlement of Mandalore resulted in a Mandalorian golden age during which warriors known as [[Mandalorian Crusaders]] embarked on a nomadic crusade. Subjugated planets, including [[Ordo/Legends|Ordo]], [[Shogun (planet)|Shogun]], [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]], and [[Gargon/Legends|Gargon]], were absorbed into [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian Space]].<ref name="TEA" /> Other worlds, such as [[Fenel]], were completely devastated and their inhabitants decimated.<ref name="TEGtW" />

In the decades leading to the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> the Mandalorians managed to conquer planets located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], including [[Basilisk]] and [[Kuar]]. In [[3996 BBY]], [[Mandalore the Indomitable]] was defeated in a [[Duel on Kuar|duel]] against [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. The Mandalorian Crusaders were forced to join [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun's]] [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]] and thus waged their crusades against the Republic.<ref name="TEA" /> The Crusaders were finally [[Battle of Onderon (Great Sith War)|defeated]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] where Mandalore the Indomitable was killed.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Aftermath==
Following the Mandalorian defeat and the end of the war, the new [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], reorganized the clans into the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]]. The subsequent war, the [[Mandalorian Wars]], turned into a massive war against the Galactic Republic for the control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />
